With this amazing helicopter tour in NYC, you’ll fly by Lower Manhattan’s Battery Park and world-renowned Wall Street, then over to greet the Statue of Liberty eye-to-eye. The awe continues as the aerial view from Ellis Island up north to the U.S.S. Intrepid unfolds before you. You fly past the 9/11 Memorial, One World Trade Center, Chrysler Building, Empire State Building, and Times Square before our highly-experienced pilots take you further up the Hudson River to Central Park, the fabled playground of New Yorkers.
